purpose: Test whether the certified lifted members of W70 and W110 acquire a two-pair-standard coset-transfer witness even though the base levels do not.

method.grade2_enumeration: meet-in-the-middle over all unordered nonzero residue pairs; complementary full unit-residue profiles; exact grade-2 verification
method.lattice_membership: fraction-free integer reducer from the authenticated ancillary S_m implementation
calibration: grade-2 counts reproduced independently established counts at m=45 (275), m=70 (700), m=110 (1648)
published m=45 two-pair target and Q are detected in the same S_45 coset
known m=168 target and *-split beta are detected in the same nonzero S_168 coset
method.independence_boundary: The m=210/220 membership reduction re-executes the authenticated source algorithm; the independent SymPy-HNF implementation timed out at m=210 and is not claimed as a second implementation at these levels.

consequence: The published two-pair-standard coset-transfer route remains unavailable after the already-certified lifts represented by W70@210 and W110@220.
next_route: For W114, the smallest lift that activates a 5-standard family is level 570. Treat that as a new out-of-census experiment with its own resource and source contract; alternatively search other algebraic gap families before increasing level.
claim_ceiling: Mechanism-specific bounded negative result. No non-algebraicity, no general Hodge conclusion, and no P-vs-NP evidence transfer.
